- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If the user prefers a snugger fit and more aggressive tread pattern, the Merrell Moab 2 Mid Waterproof might be the better choice.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If the user needs a more relaxed fit and a lighter feel, the Keen Targhee II Mid WP could be the way to go.
